billing.faq49Q1: Me pēhea te mahi o te whakamātautau kore utu 7-rā?
billing.faq49A1: I te wā utu me whakaū koe i tētahi kāri pēke mā Stripe — e hiahiatia ana, engari kāore he utu mō ngā rā 7 ka whiwhi koe i te urunga katoa. Ka mutu te whakamātautau, ka utua aunoatia te €49/marama. Whakakore i mua i te mutunga o ngā rā 7, ā, kāore koe e utua rawa.
billing.faq49Q2: He aha tonu te utu o te €49/marama?
billing.faq49A2: Te anga autopilot: rapu ia me te tātari, whāinga kaimātaki, te studio UGC, te toronga Chrome, te Kaiwhakaputa me te mahere ihirangi, te autopilot me te Taiwhanga. Kāore te whakatupuranga AI ake i roto — ka rere mā ō ohaurunga (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) rānei ō kī API, ā, ka utua e koe ngā kaiwhakarato tika i runga i ō rātou reiti.
billing.faq49Q3: He aha i iti ake ai ngā ohaurunga i te API?
billing.faq49A3: Ka hokona e ngā kaiwhakarato ngā nama ohaurunga he iti rawa atu i ngā hekona kotahi mā te API: Ko Veo i runga i te ohaurunga Google AI he 2–10× te iti ake, ko ngā avatar HeyGen tata ki te 3× te iti ake. Ā, kāore he API tūmatanui a NotebookLM — ohaurunga anake. Ka aunoatia e te toronga te mahi i roto i ō pūkete ake, e hoatu ana ki a koe te watea-API i ngā utu ohaurunga. Kei roto ngā tau tika i te ripanga me te tātaitai i runga ake nei.
billing.faq49Q4: He aha ngā ohaurunga ka hiahiatia e au?
billing.faq49A4: E rua ngā mea e ranea ana hei tīmatanga: Google AI Pro (€21.99/marama — ataata Rere + NotebookLM me ngā tepe teitei ake) me HeyGen Creator ($29/marama — tata ki te 30 meneti o Avatar IV). He tepe kore utu hoki tō ia ratonga (Rere — 50 nama/rā, NotebookLM — 3 tirohanga/rā, HeyGen — 3 ataata/marama), nō reira ka taea e koe te whakamātau i te paipa kāore he ohaurunga rawa.
billing.faq49Q5: Ka taea e au te mahi me ngā kī API anake?
billing.faq49A5: Āe. Honoa ō kī (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) ki Ngā Tautuhinga, ā, ka whakatupuria e te ratonga ki a rātou tika, kāore he toronga e hiahiatia ana. Ka utua e koe aua ratonga i runga i ō rātou reiti. Ka uru noa ngā ara: ngā avatar i runga i te ohaurunga, te reo-ā-waho mā te API, hei tauira.
billing.faq49Q6: Me pēhea taku whakakore? Kei hea te pātene?
billing.faq49A6: Kei runga i tēnei whārangi, i te kāri “Tō mahere”, ka puta te pātene “Whakaweto i te whakahou aunoa” i te wā e hohe ana tētahi ohaurunga. Kāore e whakahokia ngā utu mō ngā wā utu, engari ka mau tonu te urunga tae noa ki te mutunga o te wā. Whakawetohia i te wā whakamātautau, ā, kāore rawa koe e utua. Ka taea e koe te tīmata anō i roto i te pāwhiri kotahi i mua i te mutunga o te wā.
billing.faq49A7: Āe. Whakaurua he waehere whakatairanga ki runga — ka whai mana te hekenga i te wā e utu ana i te Premium mā Stripe.
billing.disclaimer49: Kāore a TrendTraffic i te hono ki a Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Blotato rānei. Ka aunoa te toronga i ngā mahi i roto i ō ake pūkete — whai i ngā tikanga ratonga a ia kaiwhakarato. Ko ngā utu a ngā kaiwhakarato i tangohia mai i ngā rārangi utu mana mai i Hūrae 2026, ā, ka rerekē pea.

ttLanding.f1Text: Karapa i ngā papaaho e toru mā te niche me te rohe-ā-geo. "Whāinga Kaimātaki": whakaahuatia tō hua — ka whakakī aunoa te AI i te kaimātaki, ka kōwhiri i ngā kupu matua i roto i ngā reo 29, ka kitea ngā niches me te hiahia tūturu. Ngā hongere whakataetae i roto i te rārangi mātakitaki me te hītori inenga.
ttLanding.f1Title: Ngā Ia — i mua i ētahi atu
ttLanding.f2Text: Whakapirihia tētahi hononga ki tētahi ataata TikTok, Instagram, YouTube rānei — ka wehewehe a Gemini i ia anga: matau, manawataki, hanganga, tapanga. Ka uru te wehewehenga me ngā hauraro ki te taiwhanga, ā, ka ārahi aunoa a "TrendDNA" i tō ataata ā muri ake nei.
ttLanding.f2Title: Tunu mō te viral — anga mā te anga
ttLanding.f3Text: E whā ngā aratau: takitahi, kōrerorero tangata-rua, tō tuhinga "pēnei tonu", ārahi i runga i te tātari ia. Ngā ahua HeyGen kua reri, he avatar rānei mai i tō whakaahua, ngā reo ElevenLabs katoa tae atu ki ngā tārua, ngā momo hauraro ora, me ngā kete waitohu.
ttLanding.f4Text: Ka huri te aroturuki ia i ngā kitenga hei ataata kua reri i runga i tō tauira. Ka tohatoha aunoa ngā mekameka whakaputa-aunoa i ngā hōputu puta noa i ngā papaaho me ngā mokamoka — ka whiwhi a TikTok, YouTube, me Instagram i ngā ihirangi i runga i te wā.

Waihangahia he kī whaiaro i roto i ngā Tautuhinga, whakapirihia ki Claude, ā, ka karapa te kaiawhina i ngā ia, ka whakaaro i ngā kaimātaki me ngā kupu matua, ka whakaatu i tō taiwhanga me tō rārangi whakaputa. Ngā rerenga kōrero māmā, kāore he ripa.
ttLanding.mcpEx1: Karapa i ngā ia mō te niche “skincare” i te rohe o Amerika
ttLanding.mcpEx2: Whakaaro i te kaimātaki whāinga me ngā kupu matua mō taku hua
ttLanding.mcpEx3: Kua kitea ngā ataata 12, ko ngā 3 o runga mā te whai wāhi kei roto kē i te Taiwhanga. Ko te wāhi whakaputa e whai ake nei ko āpōpō i te 09:00.

ttLanding.pageDescription: Ka kitea e TrendTraffic ngā ia viral i runga i TikTok, Instagram, me YouTube, ka wehewehe i ia anga, ka whakahiato i ngā ataata UGC me ngā avatar AI — me te whakaputa kua whakaritea me te penapena AI tae atu ki te 4x.
ttLanding.pageTitle: TrendTraffic — ngā ataata ia i runga i te aunoa
ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — te uru katoa ki ngā kōwae katoa. Ngā rā 7 tuatahi kore utu, kāore he utu, whakakore i ngā wā katoa.
ttLanding.savBody: Ka hono tō mātou toronga Chrome motuhake i ngā ratonga AI mā te whakamahi i ō ohaurunga o nāianei hei utu mō te nama nama API. Ā, ko ō kī ake (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — ka mahi tika, me te kore he tohu takawaenga.
ttLanding.savRow1Now: mā te ohaurunga — tata ki te $1 ia meneti
ttLanding.stBody: Rapu ia, wetewete ataata viral, avatars, reo irirangi, kupu hauraro, ataata i hangaia aunoa, me te tuku aunoa—katoa i te wahi kotahi. Honoa o kī ratonga ake, o ohaurunga rānei, ka utu i te huarahi tino whai hua mō koutou.
ttLanding.stTitleL2: hei utu mō ngā ohaurunga AI tekau.
ttLanding.stat1: whakaiti utu avatar me te ohaurunga
ttLanding.stat4: rā o te mahere ihirangi kei mua
ttLanding.step1Text: Ka kapi i tā mātou matawai a TikTok, Instagram, me YouTube i runga i tō niche, rohe, me te reo. Ka tautohu tō mātou AI targeter i ngā micro-niche me ngā kupu matua, ka whakatau i a rātou i runga i te hiahia tūturu.
ttLanding.step2Text: Ka wetewetehia e Gemini analytics ngā ataata viral ki ngā matau, te manawataki, me te hanganga. Ka whiwhi koe i te TrendDNA—he tohutaka mō tō whare ataata, me ngā kupu hauraro taketake.
ttLanding.step3Text: Ka hangaia e tō mātou studio UGC ngā ataata avatar AI: ngā ahua kua oti te hanga, he avatar rānei mai i tō whakaahua, ngā reo ElevenLabs i roto i ngā reo 29, ngā tapahi, ngā kupu hauraro, me tētahi kete waitohu. Ngā hōputu 9:16 me 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Ka aroturuki a Autopilot i ngā ia, ka whakahiato ataata mā te whakamahi i ngā tauira, i te wā ka whakaritea e te Publisher mō ngā rā 35 ki mua: 9:16 mō TikTok, 16:9 mō YouTube.
ttLanding.stubSoon: Kei te whanake tēnei wāhanga—ka tae mai ngā ihirangi ākuanei.

storyboard.genIntroFlow: Miihini Rere (hāwhe-aunoa): tikiake i ngā rauemi wāhanga, whakaputa i Google Flow (Omni Flash, 9:16, "pupuri i te oro taketake"), tiakina te topenga "Ki te Taiwhanga" me te toronga — ā, āpitihia ki konei. Mā mātou anō e whakakikoruatia te reo o te wāhanga.
storyboard.genIntroOmni: Miihini Omni Flash: kotahi te whakaputanga mō ia wāhanga — ka "ora" te anga tīmatanga kia rite ki te akiaki paewhiri, me tō reo taketake kua whakakikoruatia. Utu ≈$1/wāhanga (~10s × $0.10) mai i tō kī Gemini. Wāhanga 1 tuatahi!

storyboard.genIntroFlow2: Miihini Rere — Aunoa: whakatuwheratia labs.google → Rere i tō pūtirotiro me te toronga TrendTraffic, ka pāwhiri i te pātene i raro. Ka tukuna aunoa e te toronga te wāhanga me te papakupu, ka whakauru i te akiaki, ka whakaputa, ka whakahoki mai i te topenga — wāhanga mā te wāhanga, ahakoa he ataata roa (tepe Rere ~8s/topenga, nō reira ka tapahia ki te 8s). Mā mātou anō e whakakikoruatia te reo taketake. Aratau ā-ringa — ngā pātene i runga i ngā kāri.
